title:
Epic triggered by `INITIAL_RENDER` action on Reliability.AssetClassDetailExpectedSensorListGrid
Purpose: To set the active tab to `Failure Modes` on AssetClass Detail page when we click on `Review Failure Modes` from Mapping Configuration page
Condition: This behaviour occurs only when we try to navigate to the assetclass detail page from the mapping configuration page, which adds query param
`source=mappingConfig` to the url. If the url does not contain the `source` query param, it sets the active tab to be `Expected Sensors tab`
name: AssetClassSetActiveTabEpic
